subsystems.name: Microphone array
subsystems.role: captures the wearer's voice and nearby speakers while rejecting noise.

subsystems.name: Speech recognition engine
subsystems.role: turns streaming audio into text in real time.

subsystems.name: Translation engine
subsystems.role: converts text from one language to another with context.

subsystems.name: Speech synthesis engine
subsystems.role: speaks the translated text back in a natural voice.

subsystems.name: Wireless and compute link
subsystems.role: sends audio to a phone or cloud and returns translated speech fast enough to feel live.

subsystems.name: Power and audio output
subsystems.role: runs the earbuds for hours and plays the translation into the ear.

buildSteps.title: Design the acoustics
buildSteps.detail: Place microphones to pick up the wearer's voice and outside speech, then tune the earbud fit and seal to reduce noise.

buildSteps.title: Collect and clean speech data
buildSteps.detail: Gather multilingual audio with many accents, background noises and speaking styles, then label and transcribe it.

buildSteps.title: Train the speech recogniser
buildSteps.detail: Train acoustic and language models to convert streaming audio into accurate text with low latency.

buildSteps.title: Train the translation model
buildSteps.detail: Train on large parallel text and speech corpora so the system handles idioms, names and incomplete sentences.

buildSteps.title: Train the voice synthesiser
buildSteps.detail: Train neural text-to-speech models to produce natural, intelligible speech in the target language.

buildSteps.title: Integrate the pipeline
buildSteps.detail: Chain recognition, translation and synthesis so audio flows continuously instead of waiting for whole sentences.

buildSteps.title: Optimise for latency and power
buildSteps.detail: Use streaming inference, model compression and on-device chips to cut delay and battery drain.

buildSteps.title: Test in real conversations
buildSteps.detail: Run field tests with noisy streets, group discussions and many language pairs, then fix failure cases.

buildSteps.title: Manufacture and assemble
buildSteps.detail: Build the earbuds, flash the models, calibrate microphones and pair them with a phone app.

prerequisites.why: converts spoken audio to text, but accuracy drops in noise and with heavy accents.
translates text between languages, though low-resource languages and casual speech remain harder.
generates natural-sounding speech, but must run fast enough to feel conversational.
Bluetooth links add delay; newer low-latency modes help but are not universal.
running large speech and translation models locally needs chips that are still improving.
training good models requires large, diverse, legally usable corpora.

pathway.milestone: push-to-talk or one-way translation in earbuds
pathway.unlocks: basic travel and simple conversation help.

pathway.milestone: near-real-time duplex translation with automatic turn-taking
pathway.unlocks: smoother back-and-forth conversation without pressing buttons.

pathway.milestone: simultaneous interpretation that separates and translates multiple speakers
pathway.unlocks: meetings and group settings where several languages are spoken.

pathway.milestone: offline, low-power translation across many languages on the earbud itself
pathway.unlocks: private, reliable use anywhere without a phone or network.
